arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ق وَالقُرءانِ المَجيدِ
transliteration: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi
translation: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an

arabic: بَل عَجِبوا أَن جاءَهُم مُنذِرٌ مِنهُم فَقالَ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا شَيءٌ عَجيبٌ
transliteration: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun
translation: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing

arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجعٌ بَعيدٌ
transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun
translation: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return

arabic: قَد عَلِمنا ما تَنقُصُ الأَرضُ مِنهُم وَعِندَنا كِتٰبٌ حَفيظٌ
transliteration: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun
translation: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book

arabic: بَل كَذَّبوا بِالحَقِّ لَمّا جاءَهُم فَهُم فى أَمرٍ مَريجٍ
transliteration: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin
translation: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case

arabic: أَفَلَم يَنظُروا إِلَى السَّماءِ فَوقَهُم كَيفَ بَنَينٰها وَزَيَّنّٰها وَما لَها مِن فُروجٍ
transliteration: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin
translation: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein

arabic: وَالأَرضَ مَدَدنٰها وَأَلقَينا فيها رَوٰسِىَ وَأَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ زَوجٍ بَهيجٍ
transliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin
translation: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon

arabic: تَبصِرَةً وَذِكرىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبدٍ مُنيبٍ
transliteration: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin
translation: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave

arabic: وَنَزَّلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً مُبٰرَكًا فَأَنبَتنا بِهِ جَنّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ الحَصيدِ
transliteration: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi
translation: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops

arabic: وَالنَّخلَ باسِقٰتٍ لَها طَلعٌ نَضيدٌ
transliteration: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun
translation: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters

arabic: رِزقًا لِلعِبادِ وَأَحيَينا بِهِ بَلدَةً مَيتًا كَذٰلِكَ الخُروجُ
transliteration: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju
translation: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead

arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ وَأَصحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمودُ
transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu
translation: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud

arabic: وَعادٌ وَفِرعَونُ وَإِخوٰنُ لوطٍ
transliteration: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin
translation: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

arabic: وَأَصحٰبُ الأَيكَةِ وَقَومُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعيدِ
transliteration: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi
translation: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect

arabic: أَفَعَيينا بِالخَلقِ الأَوَّلِ بَل هُم فى لَبسٍ مِن خَلقٍ جَديدٍ
transliteration: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin
translation: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation

arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ وَنَعلَمُ ما تُوَسوِسُ بِهِ نَفسُهُ وَنَحنُ أَقرَبُ إِلَيهِ مِن حَبلِ الوَريدِ
transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi
translation: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

arabic: إِذ يَتَلَقَّى المُتَلَقِّيانِ عَنِ اليَمينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمالِ قَعيدٌ
transliteration: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun
translation: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left

arabic: ما يَلفِظُ مِن قَولٍ إِلّا لَدَيهِ رَقيبٌ عَتيدٌ
transliteration: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun
translation: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready

arabic: وَجاءَت سَكرَةُ المَوتِ بِالحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ ما كُنتَ مِنهُ تَحيدُ
transliteration: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
translation: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun

arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الوَعيدِ
transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi
translation: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day

arabic: وَجاءَت كُلُّ نَفسٍ مَعَها سائِقٌ وَشَهيدٌ
transliteration: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun
translation: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness

arabic: لَقَد كُنتَ فى غَفلَةٍ مِن هٰذا فَكَشَفنا عَنكَ غِطاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ اليَومَ حَديدٌ
transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun
translation: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

arabic: وَقالَ قَرينُهُ هٰذا ما لَدَىَّ عَتيدٌ
transliteration: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun
translation: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony)

arabic: أَلقِيا فى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفّارٍ عَنيدٍ
transliteration: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin
translation: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate

arabic: مَنّاعٍ لِلخَيرِ مُعتَدٍ مُريبٍ
transliteration: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin
translation: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter

arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَأَلقِياهُ فِى العَذابِ الشَّديدِ
transliteration: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi
translation: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom

arabic: قالَ قَرينُهُ رَبَّنا ما أَطغَيتُهُ وَلٰكِن كانَ فى ضَلٰلٍ بَعيدٍ
transliteration: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin
translation: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error

arabic: قالَ لا تَختَصِموا لَدَىَّ وَقَد قَدَّمتُ إِلَيكُم بِالوَعيدِ
transliteration: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi
translation: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning

arabic: ما يُبَدَّلُ القَولُ لَدَىَّ وَما أَنا۠ بِظَلّٰمٍ لِلعَبيدِ
transliteration: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi
translation: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves

arabic: يَومَ نَقولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امتَلَأتِ وَتَقولُ هَل مِن مَزيدٍ
transliteration: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin
translation: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come

arabic: وَأُزلِفَتِ الجَنَّةُ لِلمُتَّقينَ غَيرَ بَعيدٍ
transliteration: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin
translation: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant

arabic: هٰذا ما توعَدونَ لِكُلِّ أَوّابٍ حَفيظٍ
transliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin
translation: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one

arabic: مَن خَشِىَ الرَّحمٰنَ بِالغَيبِ وَجاءَ بِقَلبٍ مُنيبٍ
transliteration: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin
translation: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart

arabic: ادخُلوها بِسَلٰمٍ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الخُلودِ
transliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi
translation: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality

arabic: لَهُم ما يَشاءونَ فيها وَلَدَينا مَزيدٌ
transliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun
translation: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us

arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هُم أَشَدُّ مِنهُم بَطشًا فَنَقَّبوا فِى البِلٰدِ هَل مِن مَحيصٍ
transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin
translation: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَذِكرىٰ لِمَن كانَ لَهُ قَلبٌ أَو أَلقَى السَّمعَ وَهُوَ شَهيدٌ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun
translation: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence

arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما فى سِتَّةِ أَيّامٍ وَما مَسَّنا مِن لُغوبٍ
transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin
translation: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us

arabic: فَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ قَبلَ طُلوعِ الشَّمسِ وَقَبلَ الغُروبِ
transliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi
translation: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun

arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّحهُ وَأَدبٰرَ السُّجودِ
transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi
translation: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations

arabic: وَاستَمِع يَومَ يُنادِ المُنادِ مِن مَكانٍ قَريبٍ
transliteration: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin
translation: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place

arabic: يَومَ يَسمَعونَ الصَّيحَةَ بِالحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الخُروجِ
transliteration: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji
translation: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)

arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نُحيۦ وَنُميتُ وَإِلَينَا المَصيرُ
transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru
translation: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying

arabic: يَومَ تَشَقَّقُ الأَرضُ عَنهُم سِراعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشرٌ عَلَينا يَسيرٌ
transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun
translation: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make)

arabic: نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَقولونَ وَما أَنتَ عَلَيهِم بِجَبّارٍ فَذَكِّر بِالقُرءانِ مَن يَخافُ وَعيدِ
transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
translation: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat
